items.title: Wellman Braud Interview, 1958-03-31
items.q: Never heard nobody play like Eddie Continental.

ctx.x: Are there any of these tunes you'd like to hear that you bring with Oren? Mahogany Hall, Sugar Blues, Georgia Kent, Meetin' Snaggett? Let's hear Snaggett. I didn't hear that. We'll play that jazz band ball.

That's what I want to hear. That's what I want to hear. We'll play jazz band ball. We'll play snaggett. We'll play snaggett. Never heard nobody play like Eddie Continental. Eddie move in 59th Street. Oh, he is.
Oh, I didn't know that. We'll play jazz band ball. Never heard nobody play like Eddie Continental.
